name: Healing Herb
description: A common medicinal herb used to treat minor wounds and make basic healing medicine.

name: Moon Grass
description: A faintly glowing herb often used to make fever medicine and stabilize unstable magic.

name: Bitter Root
description: A bitter medicinal root commonly used to make painkillers and antidotes.

name: Silver Leaf
description: A rare medicinal leaf used in stronger healing potions and purification medicine.

name: Red Mushroom
description: A forest mushroom that can strengthen the effect of brewed potions after proper treatment.

name: Mana Crystal Shard
description: A small crystal shard containing magical energy, often used in alchemy and mana potion crafting.

name: Clear Spring Water
description: Clean spring water used as a base ingredient for many simple potions.

name: Beast Bone Powder
description: Powder made from beast bones, often used to strengthen medicine for wounds and physical recovery.

name: Small Health Potion
description: A basic potion that restores a small amount of health and is useful for minor injuries.

name: Medium Health Potion
description: A stronger healing potion suitable for serious wounds and battlefield recovery.

name: Small Mana Potion
description: A basic potion that restores a small amount of mana, often used by apprentices and support mages.

name: Medium Mana Potion
description: A stronger mana potion suitable for long spellcasting, military support, and magical operations.

name: Antidote Potion
description: A potion used to relieve common poison effects from forests, caves, and swamps.

name: Fever Medicine
description: Medicine used to reduce high fever and treat abnormal heat-related symptoms.

name: Wound Salve
description: A medical salve applied to cuts, scratches, and battlefield wounds.

name: Purification Potion
description: A potion used to cleanse mild corruption, pollution, or unstable magical residue.
